description.value: This government-operated BCLIQUOR retail store sits on Sidney's main commercial strip, Beacon Avenue, offering wine, spirits, beer, ciders, and non-alcoholic products. As one of 198 provincial locations, it provides a wide selection and knowledgeable staff for food and beverage pairings. A touring cyclist passing through Sidney could use it as a resupply point for evening camp or accommodation beverages.
